content.title: Jharkhand Chief Electoral Officer Appeals for Electoral Roll Inclusion
content.caption: K. Ravi Kumar, Jharkhand's Chief Electoral Officer, urges citizens to include their names in the electoral roll for the final BLO-BLA-2 meetings on November 18.

slides.heading: Jharkhand Chief Electoral Officer Appeals for Electoral Roll Inclusion
slides.text: K. Ravi Kumar, Jharkhand's Chief Electoral Officer, urges citizens to include their names in the electoral roll for the final BLO-BLA-2 meetings on November 18.

slides.heading: Jharkhand's Final BLO-BLA-2 Meetings
slides.text: Jharkhand's Chief Electoral Officer, K. Ravi Kumar, is urging citizens to include their names in the electoral roll for the final BLO-BLA-2 meetings on November 18.

slides.heading: Why Include Names in Electoral Roll?
slides.text: K. Ravi Kumar explains that the final BLO-BLA-2 meetings are held to provide additional opportunities for eligible Indian citizens who have not yet had their names added to the electoral roll.
